body.statement: For every compatible completion \(Q\), trial \(e\), and covariate stratum \(x\), \(T_{e,x}=H^Q_{e,x}C_x\). Therefore \(\operatorname{rank}(A_{P,x})\le q_x(|V|-1)\le\min\{L,d\}(|V|-1)\) for each \(x\), and \(\operatorname{rank}(A_P)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\operatorname{rank}(A_{P,x})\le(|V|-1)\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}q_x\).
body.justification: The ceiling distinguishes information supplied by more treatment comparisons from information absent because the common proxy kernel is low rank.
body.gap: Miao et al. make proxy rank central in one proximal problem but do not tensor that ceiling with a treatment-incidence network.
body.consumer: Trial planners can rule out futile edge additions when proxy rank, rather than network connectivity, is binding.
